description: Spins with its shinai while leaving a fire trail from it, then strikes at the enemy's head.

description: Pierces any enemy with the Sturm Stinger.

name: Schwarz Nagel
description: Tears the enemy to pieces with the Zasshu Shield.

name: Bow Cutter
description: Slashes with the bow on its side as if it were a blade.

name: Foot Shot
description: A trick-shot that fires arrows from its feet.

name: Turbulence Arrow
description: Fires a random flurry of arrows from its arm without missing a single shot.

description: Chops up the enemy with a single blow from its claws.

name: Hyper Launcher
description: Fires a long-range, high-power energy shot.

name: Zeke Flame

name: Final Strikes

name: Destroy Smasher
description: Spins around very rapidly, firing from the gun on its tail in all directions.

name: Zeninage
description: Tosses a fellow Zenimon at the enemy.

name: Snipe Sting
description: Precisely attacks the opponents vitals with its sword.

name: Twinkle Shoot
description: Throws its sword, which seeks out the opponent until it lands a blow.

name: Midnight Fantasia
description: Manipulates young, sleeping digimon nearby by whistling.

name: Raptor Grapple
description: Grabs the foe and lifts them high in the air, then dives down and flings them to the ground.

name: Kouyouhoujou: Kamon no Jin
description: Raises a waterspout by freely spinning its astonishing super-heavyweight class Kouyouhoujou staff.

name: Kouyouhoujou: Taki no Jin
description: Strikes the ground with its staff to shatter it and release a raging current.

name: To Shishun-kyou
description: Brings the hearts of wild Digimon back to their senses by making them listen to endless words of gratitude.

name: Kochoumu-kyou
description: Manifests the ordeals that it has suffered and showers them on the opponent.

name: Mugen Danmakushin-kyou
description: Displays an illusion that its scattered rosary beads are endlessly attacking the opponent from all directions in order to crush their spirit.

name: Free Death Fall
description: Continuously displays illusions of being knocked to the ground 10,000 times.

name: Kill Me
description: Manipulates the surrounding Digimon to assault the enemy who is being haunted.

name: Satori Henro Shou
description: Enlightens those who challenge it to battle that conflict is meaningless by having them endlessly fight against an illusion on top of its palm, so in the end both their mind and body are exhausted.

name: Reikou-Kumo-no-Ito
description: Purifies and remedies evil by illuminating the opponent with a halo that cannot be shut out even if they close their eyes.

name: Taijou Shingon
description: Crushes hostility with a thundering voice, knocking the opponent away beyond the horizon.

name: Dynamite Soul
description: Rekindles the weakened hearts of dispirited Digimon by shouting passionate phrases at them.

name: Astro Bomber
description: Turns into a flaming star that creates a huge crater when it falls to earth.

name: Ryūsei Rock Damashī
description: Shoutmon EX6 fires Shooting Starmon at the enemy with a straight punch.

name: Brave Beat Rock Double Xros
description: Fuses OmegaShoutmon's red flames and ZekeGreymon's blue flames, clothes its body with hellfire that purifies all corruption, and assaults the opponents like a meteor, vaporizing them.

name: Electric Buster Xros
description: Fires spheres of electricity from the Electric Buster Xros on its right arm.

name: Trident JusFang
description: A powerful blow from the claws of the Trident JusFang on its left arm. Slashes with the blades on its right arm.

name: Hyper Rock Magnum
description: Fires homing bullets of flame from the Trident JusFang.

name: Sol Calibur
description: Slashes with the blade on its right wrist.

name: Demolition Horn
description: Unleashes a devastating punch with the drill on its left wrist.

name: Helio Slasher
description: Soars towards the opponent and cuts them to pieces while burning them to cinders with a single brandish.

name: Space Chakram
description: Launches a ring-shaped vacuum blade to cut the opponent to pieces.

name: Xros Shooting Rocker
description: Sets its McField-brand mic on fire, then swings it down on an enemy, causing an explosion in the face of Xros Heart's logo.

name: Xros Burning Rocker
description: Uses its passionate soul that longs for peace in the middle of the battlefield to light its McField-brand mic in hellfire, then grandly swings it down.

name: Double Flare Buster
description: Shoots all of its energy from the Zanahoria in its left hand.

name: Seven Victorize
description: Concentrates its entire aura in its chest and fires it from its "V".

name: All Omega the Fusion
description: Covers itself in an Omegamon-shaped aura then charges in.

name: Seven Victorize Maximum
description: Concentrates its entire aura in its chest and fires it from its "V", along with six other "V"s.

name: Final Xros Blade
description: Slashes its McField-brand mic, which has been transformed into a greatsword by concentrating energy, downward from overhead. This technique only harms Digimon with evil hearts, and resets the data of such Digimon and reduces them to Digitamas.

name: Giga Heartbreak Attack
description: Attacks with an electrified heart of pink energy.

name: Kiendan
description: Shoots a fireball from its mouth.

name: Ginkaku Tokkan
description: Capitalizes on its large build by lowering its back and charging to crush the opponent.

name: Kin Gin Raimeigeki
description: Exposes the opponent to high voltage when Kinkakumon is aboard in a further addition to the Ginkaku Tokkan.

name: Gyakugeki Endan
description: Fires off the Kiendan while stepping back from an opponent that has challenged it in close combat.

name: Hiden Kibakuha
description: Unleashes a combined attack using Kinkakumon's electricity and Ginkakumon's hellfire.

name: Higi: Mugenei

name: Choutaiden Raikouhou
description: Amplifies and fires the energy within the Nyoikinkobou.

name: Kintoun
description: Gathers clouds and flies through the sky at high speeds.

name: Gigas Spiral

name: Timoniniser
description: Fires bullets embedded in its Gunsword that can cause a variety of different effects.

description: Draws a circular trail at high speed and summons the "Jashin Ouroboros" from it to sink the opponent into hell.

description: Attacks with a lightning-speed, surprise kick that conceals an electric shock to paralyze the opponent.

name: Wise Sword

description: Throws several star-shaped shuriken.

description: Uses its left fist, packed with piping hot steam, to strike the enemy and send them flying together with the rising heat.

description: Pours Gypt Particles inside a seized enemy's body through its tentacles, and causes them to explode from within.

name: Copy
description: Quickly creates copies of itself or Digimon it has absorbed.

description: Performs a coordinated attack with Sistermon Noir.

description: Hunts the enemy down with its scythe, which can hurl energy blades.

name: Gaia Magicar
description: Activates a magic circle beneath the enemy that fires a beam upwards, erasing them completely.

name: Bolt Break Knockdown

name: Plant Zone Cradle
description: Fires thorns from all over its body in all directions.

name: Attract Echo
description: Plays a song with its Syrinx that makes listeners lose their sense of self and see only Aegiomon.

name: Iron Trust
description: A backwards kick with its prided goat legs.

name: Stun Beat Blow
description: Beats up its opponent while releasing eletricity from its arms that numbs them and dulls their movements.

name: Destruction Trigger
description: Stomps on the opponent, then fires an explosive bullet from its legs at point-blank range.

name: Misery Bullet Rain
description: A barrage of energy bullets from its fingers followed by a barrage of live ammunition from its entire body.

name: Cook of the Hell
description: Wraps up the opponent in both of its hands, transforming their configuration data into drinking snacks, and then eating them.

name: Party of the Heaven
description: Refines alcohol mixed with deadly poisons that cause sleep or paralysis within its body, then pours it over the opponent to incapacitate them.

name: Reverse of the Dead
description: Fires the data it has consumed from its abdominal mouth as a destructive beam when it becomes too intoxicated and the patterns on its body turn pale.

name: Fly Bullet
description: Homes in on the enemy's vitals with the "Fly Bullet" fired from the Rizoma de Loto.

name: Hurricane Screw Shot
description: Wildly fires the guns hidden in the heels of its boots with a keen Senpukyaku.

name: Inferno Divide

name: Cerberus Erase

name: Famis
description: Freely manipulates plants to absorb all of the opponent's energy.

name: Chaos Rights
description: Chews the enemy with the mouths all over its body.

name: Terror's Cluster
description: Extends forth the battery on its back and fires its large-scale electromagnetic cannon.

name: Rust Breath
description: Spews deep scarlet flames that induce a rusting effect on whatever they touch.

name: Rust Claw
description: Attacks enemies with its sharp nails.

description: Sings a song in a high soprano, whose notes suffuse the listener's heart and numb their free will, leaving them at Sirenmon's mercy.

name: No.2<<Aria>>
description: Sings a solemn song in a low bass, which becomes a deep bass frequency wave that flattens the enemy through their semicircular canals, so that they are unable to even stand.

name: No.3<<Canon>>
description: Attacks the enemy using its singing voice as note-shaped shots, which are said to have the marvellous trait of ricocheting to always strike their targets, even separate enemies.

name: Divine Pierce (Satoru)

name: Protect Wave (Satoru)
description: A more powerful version of Protect Wave.

name: Mickey Bullet (Satoru)
description: A more powerful version of Mickey Bullet.

name: Bless Fire (Satoru)
description: A more powerful version of Bless Fire.

name: Punish Judge

name: Wide Plasment
description: Converts its body into extremely high-voltage plasma, inflicting divine punishment all around itself so that all those who are touched by it are completely disintegrated.

name: Triangler
description: Chops up the enemy with its three scythes.

name: Plasmadness
description: Showers the enemy with electric shocks gathered in its hands.

name: Death Dinner
description: Mounts and preys on the opponent.

name: Lightning Shower

name: Kanshaku Dust
description: Reflects the beam fired from the Kanshakudama in its abdomen off of falling stones, resulting in an attack with a large area of effect.

name: Tenbagaeshi

name: Yobori Claw Drill
description: Impales the enemy with the gigantic excavator on its left hand, which is capable of pulverising even Chrome Digizoid alloy.

name: Gewaltschwärmer
description: Fires a volley in all directions.

name: Platzenkreuz
description: Pins the enemy to the ground with its feet and shoots them at point-blank range.

name: Der Blitz
description: Picks off the enemy's vitals with the six-chambered revolvers on both of its hands.

name: Tekken Seibai
description: Slices the enemy to pieces with the blades on its arms while moving at high speed.

name: Un Pour Tous
description: Fires a beam of energy from a triangular shield formed by "Atho", "René", and "Por".

name: Needle Hive
description: Repeatedly stabs the enemy with the katars equipped to both its arms.

name: Grace Lance
description: Auto-attacks surrounding enemies with its sentient lances.
